assessment_objectives.objective: embedded technologies (e.g., firmware, microcontrollers, Operational Technology (OT), Internet of Things (IoT) and other purpose-built components) within organizational Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are identified and included in the scope of incident response planning.

procedures exist for detecting, reporting and responding to failures and/or incidents involving embedded technologies, including cases where the embedded technology cannot be patched, isolated or forensically imaged by conventional means.
failures and/or incidents involving embedded technologies are reported to the organizational incident response capability within a defined time period.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no more than 24 hours after discovery

assessment_objectives.objective: failures and/or incidents involving embedded technologies are contained and recovered from, including coordination with the manufacturer or supplier where firmware or component replacement is required.
root causes of failures and/or incidents involving embedded technologies are analyzed and lessons learned are incorporated into incident response procedures.
